## Endpoints
- `POST /api/v1/reservations` reserves an available copy. Request body: `copyId`. Response body: `Reservation` (201). Errors: 401, 404, 409.

## Data models
### Reservation
- `id`: string
- `copyId`: string
- `pickupBy`: date

## Authentication requirements
Bearer token of the signed-in reader.

## Notes
A reservation is created for the signed-in reader.
